title: Limit shape, avalanches, and stabilisation of abelian sandpiles on comb lattices
summary: We study two aspects of the abelian sandpile model on comb lattices. First, we prove that the infinite-volume limit of the stationary measures is supported on the saturated configuration. We then investigate the shape of avalanches induced by adding a particle at the origin in finite boxes of size $(2n+1)\times(2n+1)$ around the origin. In the stationary distribution on these finite boxes, we show that avalanches reach the boundary along the vertical teeth with probability tending to $1$, while the horizontal spread is of order $\sqrt{n}$.
